- Strong opioid is the appropriate step here per SCD pain management guidelines

Rationale: Classic vaso-occlusive crisis in known SCD patient with failed non-opioid therapy, significant pain behavior (immobile, short sentences), and autonomic signs (tachycardia) warranting strong opioid analgesia per SCD pain guidelines.
